step: R5/R6 legal correction — separate 102 from 103 properly

ceo_directive_compliance.directive: R5: Do not call multiple-paper evidence §102. Find strongest SINGLE reference. Map every R5 limitation to that one reference. If no single reference contains all limitations: §102 = NOT_ESTABLISHED. Then run §103 combination analysis separately. R6: Retrieve exact issued claims of JP2012071135A. Bind claim text into evidence registry. Map every R6 limitation against actual claims. Do not rely on abstract alone.
ceo_directive_compliance.principle: No single reference → no §102. Multiple references + motivation → §103. Abstract overlap → threat, not anticipation. Search count → discovery signal, not patent proof.

R5_CORRECTED_ADJUDICATION.v15_error: V15 said '102: LIKELY — multiple references teach obstruction prevention through catheter geometry.' This is WRONG — §102 requires a SINGLE reference disclosing every element. Combining references belongs in §103.
R5_CORRECTED_ADJUDICATION.correction: §102: NOT_ESTABLISHED. No single reference was found that teaches ALL of R5's limitations (expanding cross-section + helical flow + surface texturing + eShunt-specific geometry).

strongest_single_reference.reference: 'A new ventricular catheter for the prevention and treatment of proximal obstruction in CSF shunts' (1994, Neurosurgery, DOI:10.1227/00006123-199405000-00025)
strongest_single_reference.what_it_teaches: Obstruction prevention through catheter design (some form of geometric modification)
strongest_single_reference.what_it_does_NOT_teach: The specific elements R5 proposes (helical flow inducers, expanding cross-section, surface texturing). The paper is from 1994 and its specific design is not confirmed without full-text retrieval.
strongest_single_reference.102_verdict: NOT_ESTABLISHED — this single reference may teach the CONCEPT but we have not confirmed it teaches every R5 limitation. The abstract was not available via Scopus.

references_for_combination: 1994 paper: obstruction prevention through catheter design (concept)
Flow Ventricular Catheter: clinically deployed flow-optimized catheter (flow geometry)
Biomaterial/protein adsorption paper: surface effects on obstruction (surface texturing)
Vascular stent literature: helical flow inducers (known in vascular domain)
103_analysis.motivation_to_combine: A person skilled in shunt design would be motivated to combine known anti-obstruction principles (flow optimization, surface modification, geometric design) to reduce shunt obstruction. This is the standard approach in the field.
103_analysis.103_verdict: POTENTIALLY STRONG / LIKELY — combining known anti-obstruction design principles for the eShunt is likely obvious. But a formal §103 analysis requires: (a) identifying the closest prior art, (b) identifying the differences, (c) determining whether the differences would have been obvious. This analysis has not been formally completed.

corrected_r5_status.102: NOT_ESTABLISHED — no single reference confirmed to teach all R5 limitations
corrected_r5_status.103: POTENTIALLY STRONG / LIKELY — combination of known principles is likely obvious, but formal analysis incomplete
corrected_r5_status.overall: PATENT_THREATENED — strong §103 signal but §102 not established. R5 is weakened but not definitively killed at the patent gate. A formal patent opinion is needed for final determination.

R6_CORRECTED_ADJUDICATION.v15_error: V15 relied on the ABSTRACT of JP2012071135A (Codman) without retrieving the exact issued claims. The CEO correctly noted: 'Abstract overlap → threat, not anticipation.'

correction_attempted.method: Attempted to retrieve exact claims via Google Patents (blocked by anti-bot), EPO OPS API (entity not found for JP format), and Lens patent API (access tier insufficient).

what_was_retrieved.abstract_text: A shunt having a system for reducing the risk of blockage or obstruction of the catheter apertures. The catheter has an inner lumen that includes at least two lumens at the distal end and has only one lumen at the proximal end.
what_was_retrieved.family_member_found: US2012078159A1 (US equivalent, confirmed via EPO family search, family-id 44785513)

correction_attempted.what_was_NOT_retrieved: Exact issued claims. Google Patents blocked automated access. EPO OPS returned 'entity not found' for the JP publication number. Lens patent API returned 'unable to authorize' (insufficient access tier).
correction_attempted.evidence_gap: The exact claim language of the Codman multi-lumen catheter patent has NOT been bound to the evidence registry. The abstract teaches the CONCEPT of a multi-lumen catheter for obstruction reduction, but the CLAIMS may be narrower or broader than the abstract suggests.

r6_limitations: L1: Secondary bypass lumen in eShunt
L2: Opens when primary lumen obstructs
L3: Restores drainage without clearing obstruction
102_analysis_with_available_evidence.codman_abstract_teaches: Multi-lumen catheter (at least two lumens at distal end) for reducing risk of blockage/obstruction
102_analysis_with_available_evidence.what_abstract_does_NOT_confirm: Whether the Codman claims specifically require: (a) a bypass lumen that OPENS when primary obstructs (vs always-open multi-lumen), (b) endovascular application, (c) the specific activation mechanism
102_analysis_with_available_evidence.102_verdict: THREATENED BUT NOT CONFIRMED — the abstract suggests the Codman patent teaches multi-lumen obstruction reduction, but without the exact claims, we cannot confirm §102 anticipation. The abstract teaches the CONCEPT but may not teach every R6 limitation.

references_for_combination: JP2012071135A / US2012078159A1 (Codman): multi-lumen catheter for obstruction reduction (abstract teaches concept)
US11896789B2 (Shunt Flusher): secondary drain pores activated by obstruction (another form of bypass)
Known vascular dual-lumen catheters: multiple patents teach dual-lumen vascular devices
103_analysis.motivation_to_combine: A person skilled in shunt design would be motivated to apply known multi-lumen bypass concepts to the eShunt. The Codman patent teaches the concept for VP shunts; applying it to an eShunt is a design transfer.
103_analysis.103_verdict: POTENTIALLY STRONG — if the Codman claims are as broad as the abstract suggests, combining with known eShunt design is likely obvious.

corrected_r6_status.102: THREATENED BUT NOT CONFIRMED — abstract teaches concept but exact claims not retrieved
corrected_r6_status.103: POTENTIALLY STRONG — combining Codman multi-lumen concept with eShunt design is likely obvious
corrected_r6_status.overall: STRONG_PRIOR_ART_THREAT — the Codman patent (JP2012071135A / US2012078159A1) is a strong prior-art threat to R6, but the exact claim text has not been bound. R6 is severely threatened but not definitively killed without the exact claims.
corrected_r6_status.evidence_gap_to_close: Retrieve exact issued claims of US2012078159A1 (or equivalent) via: (a) manual Google Patents access, (b) PatSnap if available, (c) USPTO Patent Public Search, or (d) direct EPO fulltext API with correct document format.

honest_epistemic_status.r5: PATENT_THREATENED — §102 NOT_ESTABLISHED, §103 POTENTIALLY STRONG. R5 is weakened but not killed. The concept of geometry-based obstruction prevention is well-established in the literature, but no single reference has been confirmed to teach every R5 limitation.
honest_epistemic_status.r6: STRONG_PRIOR_ART_THREAT — Codman multi-lumen patent is a strong threat, but exact claims not bound. R6 is severely threatened but not definitively killed without exact claim mapping.
honest_epistemic_status.what_is_needed_for_final_determination: For R5: full-text of the 1994 paper + strongest single patent on shunt anti-obstruction geometry. For R6: exact issued claims of US2012078159A1 (Codman). These require either manual patent database access or a different API approach.
honest_epistemic_status.should_r5_r6_proceed_to_physics: NO — both have strong enough patent threats that spending physics resources is not justified until the patent threats are resolved. But they should not be called 'patent-killed' until the exact evidence is bound.

constitution_compliance.ceo_directive: COMPLIED — separated 102 from 103. Did not call multiple-reference evidence §102. Did not rely on abstract alone for R6.
constitution_compliance.article_II: COMPLIED — honest about evidence gaps (exact claims not retrieved)
constitution_compliance.article_VI: COMPLIED — did not manufacture patent conclusions stronger than evidence supports
constitution_compliance.pushing_the_envelope: COMPLIED — 'Do not let the desire to kill a candidate make the legal standard weaker than the standard required to prove it.'
